meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin par white cast na chhodne wala sunscreen choose karne ke liye meri salah hai ki aap **SPF 50, PA++++ aur lightweight gel ya fluid sunscreen** dekhein. Agar aapki skin medium, dusky ya deep tone ki hai, toh transparent ya properly blended formula zyada achha rahega.

Ek important baat: sunscreen ka white cast skin tone ke saath-saath uske filters aur formulation par bhi depend karta hai. Sirf “for Indian skin” likha hona guarantee nahi hai ki woh invisible dikhega.
